name: M07H3RsAy5 {VIVERE/VITAM}
source:
Beyond our understanding lies ẞethaba, home to innocent beings shaped by the names M07h3r gives them. Before their roles begin, they grow in the Womb facility. 

Witness the development of four unique embryos and the weight of destiny M07h3r places on them.

[From [url=https://canaanthedoll.itch.io/m07h3rsay5-ver1999-viverevitam]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在超越人类认知的彼端坐落着“ẞethaba”——那里栖居着一群纯洁无瑕的生命，它们的存在形态皆由“母体”（M07h3r）所赐予的名字塑造成型。在正式履行各自的使命之前，它们都在“子宫”培育设施中孕育成长。

共同见证四枚独特胚胎的发育历程，以及“M07h3r”加诸它们身上的沉重宿命吧。

[摘自[url=https://canaanthedoll.itch.io/m07h3rsay5-ver1999-viverevitam]Itch.io[/url]]
